decisions.action: Existing canonical species name and rank agree with 2026 POWO/WCVP; no rename.
Preserve historical combination as alias, not a separate accepted species.

decisions.source_name: Agrostis vaginiflora (Torr. ex A.Gray) Torr. ex A.Gray
decisions.action: POWO lists this combination under the same accepted species.
POWO lists this historical variety as a synonym of the accepted species; do not infer individual historical specimen ID.
POWO lists historical var. minor under accepted S. vaginiflorus.
POWO lists as nom. illeg. homonym. post.; never use as accepted species name.
POWO/WCVP accepts S. neglectus separately from existing canonical S. vaginiflorus.
Historical variety under S. vaginiflorus belongs to separate accepted S. neglectus under POWO.
POWO lists S. ozarkanus as heterotypic synonym of S. neglectus; primary/other regional flora concepts differ.
Despite its parent binomial, POWO maps this variety to S. neglectus, not S. vaginiflorus; retain alternate flora concepts as source provenance.

decisions.source_name: Sporobolus neglectus var. ozarkanus (Fernald) Steyerm. & C.L.Kucera
decisions.action: POWO lists this historical variety under S. neglectus.

decisions.source_name: Automatically collapsing S. neglectus into S. vaginiflorus
decisions.action: Reject automated merge: separate accepted species and distinct diagnostic spikelet/lemma traits.

decisions.source_name: Automatically routing S. vaginiflorus var. ozarkanus into accepted S. vaginiflorus without concept review
decisions.action: Reject default alias-to-parent mapping under POWO. Preserve historical source labels and alternative regional treatment; no relabelled photos.

decisions.source_name: Existing learner S. vaginiflorus photographs and source-variety determinations
decisions.action: Existing gallery is not independently voucher-confirmed to exclude S. neglectus or historical ozarkanus concept; do not relabel, mark 100%, or alter photos. Microscopic lemma features and genuine matched material remain a hold.

decisions.source_name: Hybrid ancestry of individual S. vaginiflorus / S. neglectus specimens
decisions.action: No documented parentage for any learner specimen. Do not infer hybrids or create hybrid concepts.

decisions.source_name: S. ozarkanus and S. vaginiflorus var. ozarkanus under regional flora concepts
decisions.accepted_name: Sporobolus neglectus Nash under POWO; competing FNA/Missouri source concepts retained
decisions.action: Harms documents regional treatments that distinguish ozarkanus from neglectus and/or place it as a variety under vaginiflorus; POWO synonymizes under neglectus. Historical vouchers require specimen-by-specimen determination; do not erase source concepts.

POWO/GrassBase describes perennial; FNA key reproduced by Harms, Iowa State grass treatment and EPPO morphological section describe annual. EPPO page also contradicts itself in its ecology section. This descriptive conflict is not a name-status conflict and must not be silently normalized.

decisions.source_name: Historical S. vaginiflorus / neglectus Texas herbarium determinations
decisions.action: Harms reports several TEX/LL specimens labelled neglectus from Travis County that he considered vaginiflorus; not a blanket authority to relabel any learner photograph. Independent voucher confirmation required.

source_notes.POWO_WCVP: Live POWO/WCVP 2026-10-25 accepted name and synonym checks; accepted S. vaginiflorus and separate S. neglectus. Historical ozarkanus mapped to neglectus in POWO.
source_notes.FNA: Flora of North America (2003) key and treatment discussed/quoted by Bob Harms; original FNA publication not directly inspected in this run.
source_notes.primary_local: Bob Harms (UT Plant Resources Center), first-hand 2001-2002 and 2014 TEX/LL specimen review, reports source-label disagreement and morphological evidence. His alternative ozarkanus concept is not silently equated to POWO synonym.
source_notes.academic: Iowa State University grass treatments support distinct spikelet sizes, lemma pubescence and annual descriptions; used for authority-conflict documentation only.
source_notes.eppo: EPPO page morphological sections label both annual, but its Biology and Ecology section labels both perennial; contradiction recorded, not resolved.
source_notes.hold_boundary: Taxonomic synonymy is not a voucher or photograph identification. No unverified alias to a different canonical card; no change to public learner or science holds.
